cg.basis: Typical sedan / hatchback. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 19–23.

frontTrack.basis: 2024 Golf R 2.0T Manual features and specs — Specification as reported by the linked editorial source; not an instrumented measurement.

rearTrack.basis: 2024 Golf R 2.0T Manual features and specs — Specification as reported by the linked editorial source; not an instrumented measurement.

grip.basis: Extreme-performance summer tire (C5 Z06 class) (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical modern coupe/sedan Cd 0.30–0.36 × 22–24 ft². —  Indicative range 6.5–8.5.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.3 Hz front ride frequency (car).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.45 Hz rear ride frequency (car).

frontMotion.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.85–1.

rearMotion.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.6–0.9.

frontUnsprung.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 70–100.

rearUnsprung.basis: Independent multilink / integral link. Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 75–105.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.
